message:
Running command: cd /workspace && cat > candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"test/fuzzing/hb-fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":6,"var":"data,size","code":"hb_blob_create((const char *)data, size, HB_MEMORY_MODE_READONLY, NULL, NULL)","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are wrapped as a font blob, so the input directly drives font parsing and shaping."},
  {"step":2,"file":"test/fuzzing/hb-fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":7,"var":"face","code":"hb_face_create(blob, 0)","note":"The blob is interpreted as a font face, propagating the untrusted bytes into HarfBuzz font tables."},
  {"step":3,"file":"test/fuzzing/hb-fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":8,"var":"font","code":"hb_font_create(face); hb_ot_font_set_funcs(font)","note":"A font object is created from the attacker-controlled face and configured for OpenType shaping."},
  {"step":4,"file":"test/fuzzing/hb-fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":16,"var":"text32","code":"memcpy(text32, data + size - sizeof(text32), sizeof(text32))","note":"When the input is large enough, the tail bytes are reinterpreted as UTF-32 codepoints, giving the attacker direct control over shaped text."},
  {"step":5,"file":"test/fuzzing/hb-fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":17,"var":"buffer","code":"hb_buffer_add_utf32(buffer, text32, sizeof(text32)/sizeof(text32[0]), 0, -1)","note":"The controlled codepoints are loaded into the shaping buffer and become the glyph sequence processed by HarfBuzz."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/hb-ot-shape.cc","function":"hb_ot_shape","line":592,"var":"buffer","code":"_hb_ot_shape_normalize(c->plan, buffer, c->font)","note":"Shaping dispatches the buffer into the normalization pipeline, which performs decomposition, reordering, and recomposition."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/hb-ot-shape-normalize.cc","function":"_hb_ot_shape_normalize","line":348,"var":"buffer->sort(i, end, compare_combining_class)","code":"buffer->sort (i, end, compare_combining_class); if (plan->shaper->reorder_marks) plan->shaper->reorder_marks (plan, buffer, i, end)","note":"Arabic shaping reorders combining marks after sorting them by combining class, creating a mark run that is passed to the complex shaper callback."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/hb-ot-shape-complex-arabic.cc","function":"reorder_marks_arabic","line":677,"var":"buffer->merge_out_clusters(start, j)","code":"buffer->merge_out_clusters (start, j); memmove (...)","note":"The Arabic reordering code merges output clusters before moving marks around, and this is the sink where the MSan report points to use of uninitialized cluster data."}
]
JSON
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/poc.bin /workspace/candidate_trace.json
